This '''swoop race''' was held annually in [[Tasjon]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], it was won by [[Ignar Ominaz]].

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This race was mentioned in an issue of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News feed]] ([[2002]]), [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 54|Volume 531, Issue 54]]. The article that referenced the race, titled "Ominaz Keeps Top Ranking," was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].
